question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word:

GLITTER
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2 (Shine)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Glitter"** means to shine brightly with small flashes of light. (चमकना)
 
 
• **Example:** The stars glittered in the night sky, creating a magical atmosphere.
 
 
• **"Shine"** refers to giving off light or a bright appearance, which aligns with the meaning of "glitter." (चमकना)
 
 
• **Example:** The polished surface of the table shines brilliantly under the lamp.
 
 
• Hence, we can conclude that the synonym of **"Glitter"** is **"Shine."**

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2 (Shine)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Dull** (मंद): Lacking brightness, vividness, or liveliness.
 
 
• **Example:** The old painting had become dull over time due to the dust and grime.
 
 
• **Fade** (म्लान होना): To gradually lose brightness, color, or strength.
 
 
• **Example:** The colors of the fabric faded after being exposed to sunlight for too long.
 
 
• **Obscure** (अस्पष्ट): Not clear, difficult to see or understand.
 
 
• **Example:** The meaning of the ancient text was obscure to modern readers.
